expected: the Jevellan web app "devices" screen at phone-light, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "device Settings completes a member login, shows activity, invites and switches without signing in again"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: The settings tab strip cuts off the labels at both edges ('s' on the left, 'Projects' on the right). The tabs scroll horizontally and have arrow buttons, so they can still be reached.
The 'Automatic device choice' checkbox and its 'Coming later.' note are greyed out and low-contrast, but still readable.
The 'Open' button on the Mac.lan card looks muted or disabled next to the other devices' 'Open' buttons. That fits it being the current device, but the difference is subtle.
The text under the 'Native conversations' heading is larger than the body text on the rest of the screen.
